div.head: II As 1.1
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hit hwá dó, forgylde ðone ðeof be his were—⁊ ne beo ðam ðeofe na ðe geðingodre—oððe hine be ðam geladige.
⁊ gif hit hwa do, forgylde ðone þeof be his were — ⁊ ne beo þam þeofe no ðe geþingodre — oþþe hine be þ[am] geladie.
⁊ gif hit hwa dó forgeld þone þeof be his were — ⁊ ne sie þam þeof na ðe geðingodere — oððe hine be ðam ladige.
Si quis hoc presumat, persoluat ipsum furem secundum weram suam — et non sit ipsi furi remissius in aliquo — uel ita perneget (se adlegiet).
⁊ gif hit hwa do, forgylde ðone þeof be his were—⁊ ne beo þam þeofe no ðe geþingodre—oþþe hine be þam geladie.

And if anyone does spare such a thief, he shall either pay for him to the amount of his wergeld—though in that case the thief shall not be any the less liable to punishment—or clear himself [of the accusation] by an oath of equivalent value.

Und wenn es [das Schonen] jemand thut, bezahle er den Dieb durch dessen Wergeld — und für den Dieb sei dadurch [die Strafe] keineswegs mehr herabgehandelt — oder er schwöre sich rein [durch Eid] im Werthe von jenem [Wergeld].

And if anyone does it [the sparing], let him pay for the thief with the thief's wergild — and for the thief [the penalty] is not thereby bargained down at all — or let him clear himself [by oath] to the value of that [wergild].
